subject: Drop down list options instantly closing on Snow Leopard

messages.author: 229c4168b50d5bd0
messages.subject: Drop down list options instantly closing on Snow Leopard
parts:
I have just installed Deducer on Snow Leopard (R 2.14.0) and the drop
down menus and right click menus e.g. to select type of variable or
variable etc all just appear for a fraction of a second and then
vanish.

These aren't the main menus in the tool bar but those in dialog boxes
such as those used to select variables to plot or viewing data.

It currently makes deducer impossible to use.

Anyone any suggestion as to where the problem lies before I try a
possibly pointless reinstall. I shut down and re-opened, just in case
but this didn't help.

Many thanks,

Graham

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Drop down list options instantly closing on Snow Leopard
parts:
Graham,

What do you get when you enter sessionInfo() into the console (after
Deducer is loaded). Also, try disabling "Native look and Feel" in the
preferences and see if that helps (after restarting the program).

ian

messages.subject: Re: Drop down list options instantly closing on Snow Leopard
parts:
Ian,
I disabled the preference you noted below that and it made the problem go away.
I tried the sessioninfo() command but for some strange reason R kept repeating the line below and never got around to responding to it.  Today was the first time I'd ever encountered the repeating line below. 

"Error in gui.working.env$All_Data2.842458729144237E - 4 <- All_Data : 
  could not find function "-<-"  "

When I enter the sessioninfo() command now, which may be irrelevant, but fyi the response is:

Error: could not find function "sessioninfo"

Many thanks for your help and all that you do!

Pat
